cards.card_text: Let your hands be strong Let the work rest a while Let the priests finish it
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Let your hands be strong, you who now hear these words spoken by the prophets who were present when the foundations were laid to rebuild the temple, the house of the LORD of Hosts.

cards.card_text: Then God says, "Do not be afraid; let your hands be strong." There's 'let your hands be strong' again, and friend, my hands are a MUSTACHE, so I am doing curls RIGHT NOW.
cards.verse_text: As you have been a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid; let your hands be strong.”
